answer: Each identity binds one filed tax return: the revenue office signs its receipt hash into the canyon ledger, and the atlas maps each return to exactly one identity, with a 30 POA bond locked 90 days. A second return from one funding cluster climbs the bond spiral to 60 POA, a third to 120, doubling each rank, so 100 fakes lock 3,000 POA plus 100 real income trails, and bulk filing flags the cluster for audit. Each epoch the office re-verifies a random 5% sample within 72 hours; a failed check forfeits half the bond and freezes payouts for 3 epochs. Non-filers pass with a student proof instead.
